title: Rams are first team with reigning MVP QB and reigning Defensive Player of the Year

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rams are first team with reigning MVP QB and reigning Defensive Player of the Year
sources.description: With reigning NFL Defensive Player of the Year Myles Garrett joining reigning league MVP Matthew Stafford, the 2026 Rams will occupy a unique place in NFL history.
